presentationBoundary: These are proposed combinations of independently scoped project assets, based on reviewed project documentation. Existing project implementations and any documented links retain their own evidence boundaries. This publication establishes no new shared runtime or joint end-to-end validation.
priceBoundary: Each combination total is the sum of the current published seller-side asking references for its distinct member projects. It is an asking reference for the listed existing assets AS IS. Integration engineering, deployment, external hardware, services and third-party rights are outside the sum unless expressly agreed separately. No integration premium, discount or independent valuation is added.
ownershipBoundary: Every project remains its own independent IP asset with its own first-party rights and transfer perimeter. A proposed combination is not an additional portfolio asset.
overlapBoundary: A project may appear in several alternative combinations. Count it once within each combination. Do not add overlapping combination totals to derive a portfolio price.
transactionBoundary: Acquisition is completed separately under a definitive written agreement. No purchase, payment or transfer of intellectual property is completed through GitHub Pages. Voluntary Bitcoin contributions remain independent and acquire none of the listed projects or combinations.
